pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with distinct linear edges and sharp angular vertices. Spatial area of patches is large and relatively uniform across the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow, high-contrast light pathways. Topological nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way junctions with consistent pixel thickness across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the cervical-dorsal transition, showing high-frequency rhythmic spikes against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored avian silhouettes (likely oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge and lateral flank.
